_readme: The m.ai model registry. Every model version = a checkpoint + a sampling profile. Checkpoints live in checkpoints/ (git LFS). Slots marked awaiting-upload activate the moment you push the matching file — see UPLOAD_YOUR_WEIGHTS.md.

potus-0.5.role: decisive executive — m.ai-trained on the full mixed diet
potus-0.5.notes: phase-1 weights (16M) trained in two rounds: 1000 TinyStories, then the 1,600-doc mixed corpus (Wikipedia, web text, code, stories) with Potus identity + m.ai behavior docs. Knows its name and family. Attempts journalism; achieves recursion.

potus-chat-1.0.role: receptive chat model — potus-0.5 tuned on real conversations
potus-chat-1.0.notes: potus-0.5 chat-tuned 1,000 iters on the 3,000-conversation corpus (Alpaca, Dolly, UltraChat) with loss masking. Replies and stops instead of continuing your text. Pure conversation, no identity mixing.

ropus-0.5.role: deep reasoner — m.ai-trained on the full mixed diet
ropus-0.5.notes: phase-2 weights (51M) trained in two rounds on m.ai's own pipeline: 800 python-code docs, then a 1,600-doc mixed corpus (Wikipedia articles, web text, code, stories) with m.ai identity + behavior docs distilled from mai/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md. Loss 7.5 -> 4.2 on the mixed domain. Knows its name, attempts encyclopedic prose, remains a potato.

ropus-2.0.role: deep reasoner — v2, improved (larger mixed corpus)
ropus-2.0.notes: ropus-0.5 continued 400 iters on a 2,490-doc corpus (2x Wikipedia + web text + code + stories) + identity/behavior docs. The improved reasoner; default brain for the apps.

ropus-chat-2.5.role: receptive chat model — ropus-2.0 tuned on real conversations
ropus-chat-2.5.notes: ropus-2.0 chat-tuned on ~3,000 real instruction/response pairs (Alpaca, Dolly, UltraChat) with loss masking — it learns to produce the reply, never to echo the prompt. Checkpoint carries chat: true, so the server renders the <|user|>/<|mai|> template and stops at turn boundaries. Pure conversation, no identity mixing.

alus-1.0.role: all-in-one: text + image gen + video gen — VERSION 1
alus-1.0.notes: Seeded from the best Ropus (51M) and trained 300 iters on the 1,600-doc mixed corpus with Alus identity + m.ai behavior docs. Text core of the omni stack (alus_omni/ adds image + 30-60s video on GPU).

omni.image: alus_omni: Stable Diffusion via diffusers (needs GPU)

alus-chat-1.5.role: receptive chat model — alus-1.0 tuned on real conversations
alus-chat-1.5.notes: alus-1.0 chat-tuned 1,000 iters on the 3,000-conversation corpus (Alpaca, Dolly, UltraChat) with loss masking. Replies and stops instead of continuing your text. Pure conversation, no identity mixing.
